programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Dave is concerned that The Chipmunks are obsessed with a video game in 'Mystic Mountain', and in 'Candy Confessions', Alvin wants a skateboard, but Theodore uses the money to buy sweets.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin takes Theodore's drums, so Theodore mimics him in 'Little Drummer Boy', then in 'Special Ingredient, Alvin sabotages Theodore's pancakes.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Theodore is desperate to land the part of the monster in the school play in 'Clowning Around', then in 'Bully For You', Simon builds a homemade robot bodyguard.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin dresses Theodore like a baby to impress the girl of his dreams in 'Baby Whisperer', then in 'Let's Make A Deal', making a present for Dave, Alvin creates a snowball effect of chaos.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Theodore is training for a TV baking competition with Eleanor in 'Allergic Reaction', then in 'Lice-enced to Teach', Dave sets up a classroom in the house, and becomes the teacher.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Brittany and the girls release a video that Alvin, Simon, and Theodore can't top in 'Viral', and in 'Brothers of Dagarack', Simon asks Alvin and Theodore not to see a new movie without him.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Cheesy enlists Theodore and Alvin to steal desserts from the school kitchen in 'The Underground', then in 'Game House', Simon invents a virtual reality game that quickly gets out of hand.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Miss Miller gets robbed in 'The Great Chipmunk Detective', and in 'Guitar Hero', Alvin begrudgingly agrees to teach Miss Smith guitar, but she won't reveal why she needs to learn.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin goes all out to make a new friend in 'Talking Teddy's Revenge', then in 'Snail-A-Palooza', Alvin lies to Theodore about a fake holiday to get out of chores, but things soon get real.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin agrees not to speak for 24 hours in 'Spoiler-Itis', then in 'Something's Fishy', when Alvin and Simon think Theodore's pet goldfish has died, they try to replace it before he notices.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: When Alvin finally pushes Miss Smith too far, she quits in 'Missing Miss Smith', then in 'Monster Madness', Alvin and Simon tease The Chipettes about being scared by a movie.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin and Brittany give wildly differing versions of why the fire alarm went off in 'He Said She Said', then in 'Attack of the Zombies', Alvin and Theodore try to protect their loved ones.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Theodore mistakenly thinks he's the oldest brother in 'Big Bro Theodore', and in 'No Putts, No Glory', Alvin fools Theodore into believing he's good at mini golf which of course backfires.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Derek plans a wild party at Alvin's house in 'Animal House Party', then in 'Dr. Zap vs Electroboy', Theodore is hit by lightning and believes he's like his comic book hero.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin convinces Dave to give him his own room in 'A Room of One's Own', then in 'Carts and Crafts', Alvin inadvertently destroys Theodore's bicycle, so enters a contest to win a new bike.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin accidentally creates a potion that turns Theodore into a 30-foot giant in 'Theozilla', then in 'Doggone It', all the phones at school are missing, and Alvin is blamed.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: The Principal's cat goes missing in 'The Music Box', then in 'Special Delivery', Theodore's been mistakenly mailed off in a box, so Simon and Alvin have to get him home.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Dave's old high school visits in 'The Dinner', then in 'The Tour', The Chipmunks can't wait to go on a World tour until Theodore and Alvin realize what they'll be leaving behind.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Theodore's teddy bear gets bear-napped in 'Switcheroo', and in 'The Paperboy', when Alvin starts stealing the morning paper to sell at school, Dave blames the paperboy and refuses to pay.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: The Munks help a world-famous runner in 'Run Aimee Run', then in 'Theo vs Simon', Theodore embarks on a quest to find one thing he can do better than Simon, but it won't be so easy.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Theodore must prove he's got the right stuff in 'Lost in Space...Camp', then in 'Super Hot Chocolate', Theodore loses his sense of taste.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Dave's amnesia lets the boys skip school for skiing in 'Dave Rebooted', then in 'Germs', ,Theodore fears germs after a school talk.
